description: Figure 5 is a line plot with the x-axis labeled "Number of queries during inference" and the y-axis labeled "MRR@10". The plot shows four lines representing different query selection strategies: (1) DPR w/o query, (2) DPR w/ document expansion, (3) DPR w/ asymmetric expansion, and (4) DPR w/ asymmetric expansion. The lines are color-coded and have different markers: DPR w/o query is represented by a red line with square markers, DPR w/ document expansion by a blue line with circle markers, DPR w/ asymmetric expansion by a green line with triangle markers, and DPR w/ asymmetric expansion by a purple line with diamond markers. The plot shows that the performance of DPR w/ asymmetric expansion is generally higher than the other strategies, with the highest performance observed at the start and end of the x-axis.
